steps.reason: An alert fired; open the shared board.
steps.summary: Opened inc:subscriptions-latency for 'subscriptions p99 latency above 2s' on svc:subscriptions

queries.name: open_incident
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Open the incident for an alert (idempotent). The incident is the shared board every agent reads and writes.
MATCH (a:Alert {id: $alert_id})-[:FIRED_ON]->(s:Service)
MERGE (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})
ON CREATE SET i.status = 'open', i.opened_at = a.at, i.symptom = a.symptom, i.title = a.name
MERGE (i)-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a)
MERGE (i)-[:IMPACTS {hops: 0}]->(s)
RETURN i.id AS incident, i.status AS status, s.id AS service, a.at AS at, a.symptom AS symptom, a.name AS alert

queries.name: incident_board
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Everything the planner looks at, read fresh from the graph before every decision: steps already taken, hypotheses and their status, recalled memory.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:LOGGED]->(st:AgentStep)
WITH i, a, o, collect({tool: st.tool, target: st.target, role: st.role}) AS steps
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:HAS_HYPOTHESIS]->(h:Hypothesis)-[:SUSPECTS]->(c:Change)-[:CHANGED]->(s:Service)
WITH i, a, o, steps,
     collect({id: h.id, change_id: c.id, service: s.id, status: h.status, source: h.source, hops: h.hops,
              at: c.at}) AS hypotheses
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[x:RECALLS]->(past:Incident)
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses,
     collect({incident: past.id, score: x.score, cause_service: x.cause_service}) AS recalls
OPTIONAL MATCH (other:Alert)
WHERE other.id <> a.id AND other.at >= a.at - $storm_window AND other.at <= a.at
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses, recalls, count(other) AS storm
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[su:SHARED_UPSTREAM]->(u:Service)
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses, recalls, storm, u, su
ORDER BY su.rank
RETURN i.id AS id, i.status AS status, o.id AS service, a.id AS alert, a.at AS at, a.symptom AS symptom,
       steps, hypotheses, recalls, storm, collect(u.id) AS shared_upstream

queries.name: incident_head
queries.cypher:
// purpose: The incident's alerting service, alert time and status.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)
RETURN i.id AS incident, i.status AS status, o.id AS service, a.id AS alert, a.at AS at, a.symptom AS symptom,
       a.name AS alert_name

queries.name: storm_alerts
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Other alerts that fired in the $window seconds before this incident's alert (an alert storm).
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)
MATCH (other:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(s:Service)
WHERE other.id <> a.id AND other.at >= a.at - $window AND other.at <= a.at
RETURN other.id AS alert, other.name AS name, s.id AS service, other.at AS at
ORDER BY at

queries.name: shared_upstream
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Services that every alerting service depends on (live edges at alert time, 0..6 hops): where one common cause would have to sit.
UNWIND $services AS sid
MATCH p = (:Service {id: sid})-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(u:Service)
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.valid_from <= $at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > $at))
WITH u, count(DISTINCT sid) AS covers
WHERE covers = size($services)
RETURN u.id AS service

queries.name: chokepoints
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Graph algorithm: betweenness centrality over Service/DEPENDS_ON (algo.betweenness) ranks the shared upstream by how many dependency paths run through each service. Exact on this graph size (samplingSize > node count, fixed seed).
CALL algo.betweenness({nodeLabels: ['Service'], relationshipTypes: ['DEPENDS_ON'], samplingSize: 1000,
                       samplingSeed: 1}) YIELD node, score
WHERE node.id IN $services
RETURN node.id AS service, score
ORDER BY score DESC, service

queries.name: record_correlation
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Fold the other alerts into this incident (one incident, not one per alert), count their services as impacted, and mark the ranked shared upstream.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})
FOREACH (r IN $alerts |
  MERGE (other:Alert {id: r.alert})
  MERGE (i)-[:CORRELATED_WITH]->(other))
WITH i
UNWIND $alerts AS r
MATCH (s:Service {id: r.service})
MERGE (i)-[x:IMPACTS]->(s)
ON CREATE SET x.hops = 0, x.via = $origin
WITH DISTINCT i
UNWIND $shared AS u
MATCH (svc:Service {id: u.service})
MERGE (i)-[x:SHARED_UPSTREAM]->(svc)
SET x.rank = u.rank, x.betweenness = u.score
RETURN count(svc) AS shared

queries.name: blast_radius
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Multi-hop impact: every service that transitively depends on $service via DEPENDS_ON edges valid at $at, with its shortest path.
MATCH p = (caller:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..6]->(:Service {id: $service})
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.valid_from <= $at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > $at))
WITH caller, p
ORDER BY length(p)
WITH caller, collect(p)[0] AS p
MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(caller)
RETURN caller.id AS service, caller.tier AS tier, length(p) AS hops, t.name AS team, [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path
ORDER BY hops, service

queries.name: record_impacts
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Write impacted / at-risk services onto the incident board.
UNWIND $rows AS r
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id}), (s:Service {id: r.service})
MERGE (i)-[x:IMPACTS]->(s)
ON CREATE SET x.hops = r.hops, x.via = $via

queries.name: recall_similar
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Episodic recall by structure, not text: resolved incidents whose root-cause service is on the alerting service's live dependency path. Same symptom scores higher.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)
MATCH (past:Incident {status: 'resolved'})-[:CAUSED_BY]->(c:Change)-[:CHANGED]->(cs:Service)
WHERE past.opened_at < a.at AND past.id <> i.id
MATCH p = (o)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(cs)
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.valid_from <= a.at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > a.at))
WITH past, c, cs, a, min(length(p)) AS hops
OPTIONAL MATCH (past)-[:FIXED_WITH]->(rb:Runbook)
RETURN past.id AS incident, past.title AS title, past.symptom AS symptom, cs.id AS cause_service,
       c.kind AS cause_kind, c.id AS cause_change, hops, rb.id AS runbook, rb.title AS runbook_title,
       2 + CASE WHEN past.symptom = a.symptom THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS score
ORDER BY score DESC, past.opened_at DESC
LIMIT 5

queries.name: memory_suspects
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Procedural memory decides: for each recalled incident, the runbook that fixed it names a service and a change kind; suspect in-window changes of that kind on that service, most trusted runbook first.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)
MATCH (i)-[x:RECALLS]->(past:Incident)-[:FIXED_WITH]->(rb:Runbook)-[:FOR_SERVICE]->(cs:Service)
WHERE x.score >= $min_score
MATCH (c:Change {kind: rb.kind})-[:CHANGED]->(cs)
WHERE c.at >= a.at - $window AND c.at <= a.at
MATCH p = (o)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(cs)
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.valid_from <= a.at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > a.at))
RETURN c.id AS change, cs.id AS service, c.kind AS kind, c.at AS at, min(length(p)) AS hops,
       rb.id AS runbook, rb.title AS runbook_title, rb.successes AS successes, rb.uses AS uses,
       collect(DISTINCT past.id) AS recalled
ORDER BY toFloat(successes) / uses DESC, at DESC

queries.name: path_suspects
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Multi-hop suspects: every change in the alert window on a service the alerting service depends on at alert time, nearest first.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)
MATCH p = (o)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(s:Service)
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.valid_from <= a.at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > a.at))
WITH a, s, min(length(p)) AS hops
MATCH (c:Change)-[:CHANGED]->(s)
WHERE c.at >= a.at - $window AND c.at <= a.at
RETURN c.id AS change, s.id AS service, c.kind AS kind, c.at AS at, c.summary AS summary, hops
ORDER BY hops, at DESC
LIMIT 10

queries.name: recent_changes
queries.cypher:
// purpose: The flat baseline: newest changes anywhere before the alert, no traversal. This is what a change log alone would blame. ($since/$until are literal bounds so the Change.at range index is used.)
MATCH (c:Change)-[:CHANGED]->(s:Service)
WHERE c.at >= $since AND c.at <= $until
RETURN c.id AS change, s.id AS service, c.kind AS kind, c.at AS at, c.summary AS summary
ORDER BY at DESC
LIMIT 3

queries.name: add_hypotheses
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Put suspects on the board as open Hypothesis nodes (idempotent per incident + change).
UNWIND $rows AS r
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id}), (c:Change {id: r.change})
MERGE (h:Hypothesis {id: r.id})
ON CREATE SET h.status = 'open', h.source = r.source, h.hops = r.hops, h.created_at = $at, h.runbook = r.runbook
MERGE (i)-[:HAS_HYPOTHESIS]->(h)
MERGE (h)-[:SUSPECTS]->(c)
RETURN h.id AS id

queries.name: live_paths

MATCH p = (:Service {id: $origin})-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(:Service {id: $target})
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.valid_from <= $at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > $at))
WITH p
ORDER BY length(p)
LIMIT 20
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path

queries.name: anomalies_between

// purpose: Which of the given services showed an anomaly between the change and the alert.
UNWIND $services AS sid
MATCH (x:Anomaly)-[:ON]->(s:Service {id: sid})
WHERE x.at >= $since AND x.at <= $until
RETURN s.id AS service, min(x.at) AS first_at, collect(x.summary)[0] AS summary

queries.name: storm_unexplained
queries.cypher:
// purpose: In an alert storm: which of the other alerting services have no live dependency path to the suspect's service (so the suspect cannot explain their alerts).
UNWIND $services AS sid
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (:Service {id: sid})-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(:Service {id: $target})
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.valid_from <= $at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > $at))
WITH sid, count(p) AS paths
WHERE paths = 0
RETURN sid AS service

queries.name: record_evidence
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Attach a check's verdict as an Evidence node (SUPPORTS / REFUTES the hypothesis) and update the hypothesis status.
MATCH (h:Hypothesis {id: $hypothesis_id})
MERGE (e:Evidence {id: $evidence_id})
SET e.verdict = $verdict, e.reason = $reason, e.path = $path, e.at = $at
// A human-confirmed cause stays confirmed whatever a later re-check says.
SET h.status = CASE WHEN h.status = 'confirmed' THEN h.status WHEN $verdict = 'supports' THEN 'supported'
                    WHEN $verdict = 'refutes' THEN 'refuted' ELSE 'inconclusive' END
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN $verdict = 'supports' THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (e)-[:SUPPORTS]->(h))
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN $verdict = 'refutes' THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (e)-[:REFUTES]->(h))
WITH h
// Procedural memory learns from misses too: a runbook whose suggestion was refuted loses confidence.
OPTIONAL MATCH (rb:Runbook {id: h.runbook})
FOREACH (x IN CASE WHEN rb IS NOT NULL AND $verdict = 'refutes' THEN [rb] ELSE [] END | SET x.uses = x.uses + 1)
RETURN h.id AS hypothesis, h.status AS status

queries.name: who_knows
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Who knows a service, ranked by graph evidence: on the owning team (3), authored changes to it (2 each), was paged for it in an incident (1 each).
MATCH (s:Service {id: $service})
MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
WITH s, p, t,
     size([(s)<-[:OWNS]-(t) | 1]) AS owns,
     size(list.dedup([(s)<-[:CHANGED]-(c:Change)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(p) | c.id])) AS changes,
     size(list.dedup([(i:Incident)-[pg:PAGED]->(p) WHERE pg.for_service = s.id | i.id])) AS incidents
WHERE owns + changes + incidents > 0
RETURN p.id AS person, p.name AS name, p.handle AS handle, t.name AS team, owns > 0 AS on_owning_team,
       changes, incidents, 3 * owns + 2 * changes + incidents AS score
ORDER BY score DESC, name
LIMIT 5

ON CREATE SET x.for_service = $service, x.score = $score

// purpose: Multi-hop impact: every service that transitively depends on $service via DEPENDS_ON edges valid at $at, with its shortest path.
MATCH p = (caller:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..6]->(:Service {id: $service})

ORDER BY length(p)

MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(caller)
RETURN caller.id AS service, caller.tier AS tier, length(p) AS hops, t.name AS team, [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path
ORDER BY hops, service

RETURN i.id AS incident, i.status AS status, o.id AS service, a.id AS alert, a.at AS at, a.symptom AS symptom,
       a.name AS alert_name

queries.name: update_facts
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Facts for the status update: impact, who was paged and consulted, the supported cause with its author and sources (ticket, chat), and the runbook memory used.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[imp:IMPACTS]->(s0:Service)
WITH i, a, collect(DISTINCT {service: s0.id, via: imp.via}) AS impacts
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:PAGED]->(p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
WITH i, a, impacts, collect(DISTINCT {name: p.name, handle: p.handle, team: t.name}) AS paged
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[cx:CONSULTED]->(x:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(xt:Team)
WITH i, a, impacts, paged,
     collect(DISTINCT {id: x.id, name: x.name, handle: x.handle, team: xt.name, service: cx.for_service}) AS experts
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:HAS_HYPOTHESIS]->(h:Hypothesis)-[:SUSPECTS]->(c:Change)-[:CHANGED]->(s:Service)
WHERE h.status IN ['confirmed', 'supported']
WITH i, a, impacts, paged, experts, h, c, s ORDER BY h.status
LIMIT 1
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(author:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (src)-[:REQUESTED|MENTIONS]->(c)
// Suggest the runbook that led memory to this cause, or the one a human confirmed fixed this incident. A runbook
// that merely shares the service and change kind may fix a different failure (a full disk vs a connection limit).
OPTIONAL MATCH (rb:Runbook {id: h.runbook})
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:FIXED_WITH]->(fx:Runbook)
WITH a, impacts, paged, experts, c, s, author, src, coalesce(rb, fx) AS rb
RETURN a.name AS alert, impacts, paged, experts, c.id AS change, c.summary AS change_summary,
       s.id AS cause_service,
       author.name AS author, collect(DISTINCT src.id) AS sources,
       collect(DISTINCT {id: rb.id, title: rb.title, steps: rb.steps, successes: rb.successes,
                         uses: rb.uses}) AS runbooks

queries.name: refuted_hypotheses
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Suspects the agents ruled out, with the reason recorded on their Evidence.
MATCH (:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:HAS_HYPOTHESIS]->(h:Hypothesis)-[:SUSPECTS]->(c:Change)-[:CHANGED]->(s:Service)
MATCH (e:Evidence)-[:REFUTES]->(h)
RETURN c.id AS change, s.id AS service, c.summary AS summary, e.reason AS reason, h.source AS source

queries.name: post_update
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Post (or rewrite) the status update on the incident and link it to every node it cites; stale citations are dropped. Lookups are per label so the id indexes are used.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})
MERGE (m:Message {id: $message_id})
SET m.kind = 'status_update', m.channel = '#incidents', m.text = $text, m.at = $at
MERGE (i)-[:HAS_UPDATE]->(m)
WITH m
OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[old:CITES]->()
DELETE old
WITH DISTINCT m
UNWIND $cites AS cid
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Change {id: cid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Ticket {id: cid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (msg:Message {id: cid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (rb:Runbook {id: cid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person {id: cid})
WITH m, coalesce(c, t, msg, rb, p) AS n
WHERE n IS NOT NULL
MERGE (m)-[:CITES]->(n)
RETURN count(n) AS cited

queries.name: incident_board
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Everything the planner looks at, read fresh from the graph before every decision: steps already taken, hypotheses and their status, recalled memory.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:LOGGED]->(st:AgentStep)
WITH i, a, o, collect({tool: st.tool, target: st.target, role: st.role}) AS steps
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:HAS_HYPOTHESIS]->(h:Hypothesis)-[:SUSPECTS]->(c:Change)-[:CHANGED]->(s:Service)
WITH i, a, o, steps,
     collect({id: h.id, change_id: c.id, service: s.id, status: h.status, source: h.source, hops: h.hops,
              at: c.at}) AS hypotheses
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[x:RECALLS]->(past:Incident)
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses,
     collect({incident: past.id, score: x.score, cause_service: x.cause_service}) AS recalls
OPTIONAL MATCH (other:Alert)
WHERE other.id <> a.id AND other.at >= a.at - $storm_window AND other.at <= a.at
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses, recalls, count(other) AS storm
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[su:SHARED_UPSTREAM]->(u:Service)
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses, recalls, storm, u, su
ORDER BY su.rank
RETURN i.id AS id, i.status AS status, o.id AS service, a.id AS alert, a.at AS at, a.symptom AS symptom,
       steps, hypotheses, recalls, storm, collect(u.id) AS shared_upstream
